summary: The order-history mirror (ue_orders, ue_items) is created from store.migrateExtras via orders.Migrations so the novel commands share the generated SQLite store instead of opening a second database.
reason: The generic resources table cannot answer spend, top-items, or item-title search; typed tables with indexes are required, and they must be created on every store open so a fresh install works before the first sync.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/orders ./internal/cli: fixture sync then history/spend/top-items/top-restaurants/find all pass; LIKE wildcards are matched literally.
